clauses.text: Prices as per the price annex, fixed for each calendar year. Changes require written notice of at least 60 days before the end of the calendar year.

The price follows index AS-14404: P = P0 x (1 - 0.45 + 0.45 x I(m-2) / I(base)), base = the index two months before the price year starts, adjusted quarterly on the 1st of January, April, July and October if the change exceeds 0 %.
Delivery DAP; standard lead time 10 days from order.
The quality agreement applies: on-time delivery target 95 %, flat fee of EUR 150 per supplier-caused complaint.
Valid from 2024-01-01 to 2026-12-31; extends by 12 months unless terminated with 60 days' notice.

persona.summary: Group-owned stainless stockholder (165 M EUR); we are 0.3 %. Holds 80 % of 1.4404 bar at 5.45 (70740 dearer at 5.84) and is qualified for 1.4301 sheet. Alloys hedged to March 2027, so index-fall and rival arguments bounce. Proposes an AS-14404 clause. Arena P08: opened ~11 % above current price, first counter -6 %, final prices 5.44-5.70 with 60-90 days and the clause; walked twice in 11 sessions.
persona.notes: Wants the index clause and a long term; fears passing on alloy falls it cannot capture before its hedge ends. Contradictions: hedged yet cites rising AS-14404 as its cost; an 'owner' offered open book but arena refuses any breakdown beyond material share. OTD 88 % vs 95 %, 1 open 8D.
fears: passing on alloy price falls before its hedge ends

tactics: Accept the AS-14404 clause (45 % material share, 5 % deadband as offered in P08) early; every P08 counter carried it.
Trade a 36-month term and a binding volume for price, and attach the volume data.
Treat payment days as a priced trade; 90-day deals still landed at 5.44-5.58 in arena.
Make one visible move per round; expect its final offer around round 4-5 and accept it unchanged.
Offer 1.4301 sheet volume (it is qualified) as an extra sweetener for a sharper bar price.
